node.title: Re: Parse excel Rows for given column's
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [ArifS],

Any suggestion?

Use [doc://Data::Dumper] to look at @rows, you will see that you have an "array of arrays". How to access data structures like that is explained in [doc://perlreftut] and [doc://perldsc].

BTW, your current code appears to be 95% copy-and-pasted from [http://perlmaven.com/read-an-excel-file-in-perl|this article]. That's not necessarily a bad thing but I recommend you additionally show your own efforts in solving the problem.

Regards,
-- Hauke D
